verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents personnel-level compliance tracking: it reminds personnel to complete assigned tasks such as policy acceptance and security awareness training, and admins can add custom fields to Personnel and Tasks. That covers the 'every hire got training' half of the story. Nothing in the pack describes HR-system sync, structured onboarding/offboarding checklists, or verification that leavers lost access. Periodic user access reviews with revoke decisions are an adjacent control and earn no credit for offboarding. missing for 10: HR integration that triggers onboarding/offboarding, onboarding/offboarding checklist workflows, offboarding access-removal tracking or evidence, independent corroboration.
